When a child grows up in a toxic family environment, many parents think the best solution is to send them to a boarding school — far away from all the chaos. But does distance really heal emotional wounds? 🧠💭 

In this clip, Asst. Professor Dr. Shreedevi A U, Dept. Of Psychiatric Social Work, NIMHANS shares a powerful truth: 
 👉 Escaping the environment doesn’t heal it. 
 Children may leave for a few years, but eventually, they return — often to the same unhealed patterns. 

Together with Dr. Sunil M.R, she explains why it’s far more effective to teach kids emotional coping skills, resilience, and self-awareness — so they can navigate life with strength, not fear. 

If you’re a parent, teacher, or mental health advocate, this one’s for you. 

🎯 Watch till the end — this message might change how you see parenting forever. 

Watch the full episode on our YouTube Channel, Spotify or Apple podcast. Save and share this reel with someone who may need it.

more","cards":[],"body":{"text":"When a child grows up in a toxic family environment, many parents think the best solution is to send them to a boarding school — far away from all the chaos. But does distance really heal emotional wounds? 🧠💭 

In this clip, Asst. Professor Dr. Shreedevi A U, Dept. Of Psychiatric Social Work, NIMHANS shares a powerful truth: 
 👉 Escaping the environment doesn’t heal it. 
 Children may leave for a few years, but eventually, they return — often to the same unhealed patterns. 

Together with Dr. Sunil M.R, she explains why it’s far more effective to teach kids emotional coping skills, resilience, and self-awareness — so they can navigate life with strength, not fear. 

If you’re a parent, teacher, or mental health advocate, this one’s for you. 

🎯 Watch till the end — this message might change how you see parenting forever.
